name: lock_card_idempotent_already_locked
use_case: Handle idempotency, retryable timeouts, and service failures
branch: Customer representative requests locking card ending 7216; agent authenticates, asks confirmation, locks card, and confirms locked status.

- Name: Fiona MacLeod
- Customer ID: C116
- Session ID: SESS116
